source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.4.3, printed page 308.

blocks.text: Sulfur ke do oxides hain, sulfur dioxide aur sulfur trioxide, mil kar SOx. Yeh bunyadi taur par coal aur oil jalne se kharij hote hain. Jab SOx pani ke bukharat se mile to acid rain banti hai, jo ecosystems ko nuqsan deti hai; SO2 hawa mein tezabi jamao (acid deposition) ka bara zariya hai.

blocks.prompt: SO3 ke bajaye SO2 ko tezabi jamao ka bara zariya kyun kaha jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Jalna sulfur zyada tar SO2 ke taur par chhorta hai; us ka sirf ek hissa hawa mein SO3 mein oxidise hota hai. SO2 nami mein sulfurous acid ke taur par halti aur aahista sulfuric acid mein oxidise hoti hai, to jama hone wale acid ki miqdar bunyadi taur par kharij shuda SO2 par munhasir hai.

items: SOx = SO2 + SO3, coal aur oil jalne se; pani ke bukharat se acid rain; SO2 tezabi jamao ka bara zariya.
